SELECT users.id, users.display_name, users.email, users.username, users.password_hash, users.role, users.access_level, users.company_name, users.phone, users.phone_extension, users.shipping_name, users.shipping_address, users.billing_address, users.shipping_same_as_billing, users.assigned_promo_code, users.assigned_discount_percent, users.approval_status, users.approval_decided_at, users.approval_decided_by_user_id, users.is_active, users.created_at 
FROM users 
WHERE lower(users.display_name) = ?

INSERT INTO users (display_name, email, username, password_hash, role, access_level, company_name, phone, phone_extension, shipping_name, shipping_address, billing_address, shipping_same_as_billing, assigned_promo_code, assigned_discount_percent, approval_status, approval_decided_at, approval_decided_by_user_id, is_active, created_at) VALUES (?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?)

SELECT quotes.id AS quotes_id, quotes.quote_number AS quotes_quote_number, quotes.status AS quotes_status, quotes.customer_name AS quotes_customer_name, quotes.customer_address AS quotes_customer_address, quotes.customer_contact AS quotes_customer_contact, quotes.customer_reference AS quotes_customer_reference, quotes.comments AS quotes_comments, quotes.special_instructions AS quotes_special_instructions, quotes.order_form_snapshot AS quotes_order_form_snapshot, quotes.pricing_version AS quotes_pricing_version, quotes.revision AS quotes_revision, quotes.quantity AS quotes_quantity, quotes.discount AS quotes_discount, quotes.model_code AS quotes_model_code, quotes.cylinder_inputs_snapshot AS quotes_cylinder_inputs_snapshot, quotes.price_breakdown_snapshot AS quotes_price_breakdown_snapshot, quotes.created_by_user_id AS quotes_created_by_user_id, quotes.created_at AS quotes_created_at, quotes.edited_by_user_id AS quotes_edited_by_user_id, quotes.edited_at AS quotes_edited_at, quotes.emailed_by_user_id AS quotes_emailed_by_user_id, quotes.emailed_at AS quotes_emailed_at, quotes.approved_by_user_id AS quotes_approved_by_user_id, quotes.approved_at AS quotes_approved_at, quotes.assigned_employee_user_id AS quotes_assigned_employee_user_id, quotes.assigned_at AS quotes_assigned_at, quotes.customer_update_pending AS quotes_customer_update_pending 
FROM quotes 
WHERE quotes.id = ?
